// Command serde-probe is a FIXTURE VALIDATOR, never a criterion instrument. It
// constructs the two analyzers flowc will run once the assembler follow-up
// lands and prints their diagnostics, so the smoke's serialization fixture is
// proven a genuine violator BEFORE a criterion depends on flowc reporting it.
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/whitaker-io/machine/lang/analysis"
	"github.com/whitaker-io/machine/lang/ast"
	"github.com/whitaker-io/machine/lang/loader"
)

func main() {
	dir := flag.String("in", ".", "directory holding the .flow sources")
	pkgpath := flag.String("pkgpath", "", "import path the sources belong to")
	flag.Parse()

	pkgs, err := loader.Load(*dir, []string{"./..."})
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "load:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(*dir)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "readdir:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	var srcs []analysis.Source
	for _, e := range entries {
		if e.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".flow") {
			continue
		}
		body, rerr := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(*dir, e.Name()))
		if rerr != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "read:", rerr)
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		file, perr := ast.Parse(body)
		if perr != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "parse:", perr)
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		srcs = append(srcs, analysis.Source{Path: e.Name(), Src: body, File: file})
	}
	all := append(analysis.All(),
		analysis.TypeInferenceAnalyzer(pkgs),
		analysis.SerializationAnalyzer(pkgs, *pkgpath))
	diags, err := analysis.Run(srcs, all)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "run:", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	for _, d := range diags {
		fmt.Printf("%s:%d:%d: %s: %s [%s]\n", d.Path, d.Pos.Line, d.Pos.Col, d.Severity, d.Message, d.Code)
	}
}
